hero.title: The Punjabi Rasoi: Authentic Indian Flavors, Unforgettable Experiences.
hero.subtitle: Indulge in the rich, aromatic traditions of North Indian cooking, crafted with passion and heritage.

about.title: Our Story & Culinary Passion
about.paragraph1: At The Punjabi Rasoi, we bring the vibrant culinary heritage of Punjab directly to your table. Our chefs meticulously prepare each dish using traditional recipes, the freshest locally sourced ingredients, and a secret blend of spices passed down through generations. Experience the true essence of North India in every savory bite.
about.paragraph2: More than just a meal, dining with us is an immersive journey into India's heartland, where every plate tells a story of warmth, hospitality, and authentic flavor. We invite you to experience the true taste of Punjabi cuisine, perfected with love and dedication, in an atmosphere designed for memorable moments.
